title: Stop the doctor test helpers holding their exec target open for writing
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor/tests.rs, change write_executable_binary and write_executable_binary_raw to write the script to a sibling temp path, set the executable mode there, then rename it into the final path. The exec'd path is then never open for writing, so a sibling test's fork cannot inherit a write fd and turn a later exec into ETXTBSY.
acceptance: Both helpers create the final path via rename from a temp sibling, never by writing the final path directly; every doctor test keeps its current assertions unedited; the doctor suite is green across repeated consecutive runs.
